findings.issue: כַּאֲשֶׁר is the preposition plus relative «as / according as». «como que» is the Latin American idiom of semblance or hedge («as if», «sort of»), so the command is no longer the standard they followed.

notes: The other tokens match, including 3mp hicieron then 3ms alzó/hirió, niphal fueron vueltas, Jehová, and Yeor.
